sections.label: Competition Amendment Bill transfer functions
sections.summary: The Competition (Amendment) Bill amends the Competition Act 2004 and Enterprise Singapore Board Act 2018 to transfer product safety and legal metrology functions from Enterprise Singapore to CCCS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for t
sentences.text: he Deputy Prime Minister and the Minister of State for Trade and Industry): Mr Deputy Speaker, Sir, on behalf of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry, I move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." Sir, the Competition (Amendment) Bill amends the Competition Act 2004 and the Enterprise Singapore Board Act 2018 to transfer the product safety and legal metrology functions from the Enterprise Singapore Board to the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS).

sections.label: Transfer to single consumer agency
sections.summary: The Bill amendments seek to transfer product safety and legal metrology functions from Enterprise Singapore to CCCS to ensure greater synergy in consumer protection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for t
sentences.text: To ensure greater synergy in the administration and enforcement of consumer protection matters under a single agency, the Bill amendments seek to transfer the product safety and legal metrology functions from Enterprise Singapore to CCCS.

sections.label: CCCS product safety enforcement support
sections.summary: The speaker supports CCCS taking on product safety functions and administering the Weights and Measures Act, as it enforces the CPFTA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: As the Statutory Board responsible for enforcing the CPFTA, CCCS should have the mandate to enforce all issues related to unfair business practices across all sectors and industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: I therefore fully support the proposal for CCCS to take on the functions of ensuring product safety and to administer and enforce the Weights and Measures Act.

sections.label: Smooth transition for affected officers
sections.summary: The speaker asks how the Ministry will ensure a smooth transition for affected officers, noting a unit pricing trial later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: How does the Ministry intend to ensure a smooth transition for the affected officers?

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: This is particularly crucial as we move to embark on a unit pricing trial later this year, for common grocery items at selected outlets across our four major supermarkets.

sections.label: CPSO and WMO transferred wholly
sections.summary: Enterprise Singapore's CPSO and WMO officers and budgets will be wholly transferred from Enterprise Singapore to CCCS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Second, Enterprise Singapore's CPSO and WMO – both their officers as well as the budgets – will be wholly transferred from Enterprise Singapore to CCCS.

sections.label: Consumer Protection Review Panel convened
sections.summary: Mr Gan Kim Yong announced the Government convened a Consumer Protection Review Panel to review consumer concerns and enforcement powers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Just last month, Deputy Prime Minister and the Minister for Trade and Industry, Mr Gan Kim Yong, announced that the Government has convened a Consumer Protection Review Panel to review key consumer concerns in Singapore, such as prepayment losses, online commerce and also to assess the need to strengthen our enforcement powers and ability to deal with emerging trends.

sections.label: Safeguards Against Errant Trading Practices
sections.summary: Appropriate safeguards and enforcement actions must address errant trading practices that pose real risks, without burdening businesses and consumers, and regulations will be streamlined where possible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Where errant trading practices present real risks to consumers and honest businesses, we must make sure that appropriate safeguards and enforcement actions are in place without burdening the businesses and consumers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Where regulations can be streamlined and requirements made efficient, we will certainly pursue these solutions.
